🚀 Join AstroVital @ NASA Space Apps Cairo 2026!

We’re building an AI/ML Health Monitoring & Predictive Dashboard for astronauts using NASA GeneLab data. We have the biomedical domain core covered, but urgently need TECH TALENT:

👨‍💻 AI/ML Engineers & Data Scientists (predictive algorithms)

🎨 UI/UX Designers & Web Devs (Figma / Web dashboard mockup)

🎬 Video / Pitch Editors

Short project, clear vision, huge impact. DM me now to join! 🛸💻
